note: Probes are argv arrays run from the repo root with a 10s budget each. Facts are probed, never guessed. Every probe names the fact the v4 plan depends on.

probes.fact: the 3.0.1 gate-check runs and accepts this run's state file
which plan-it copies the harness can load (marketplaces + user skill + plugin version)
root mirrors vs the plugin copy Claude Code runs — byte parity of the 8 pairs
GitHub CLI is authenticated (the 4.0.0 release pushes to DevOtts/plan-it)
node present and the binding test runner exists (zero-dep policy)
check: node --version && test -f tests/run-contract.mjs && echo run-contract.mjs present

probes.fact: external pieces the renderer leans on: Google Chrome for --open, cdnjs for mermaid
check: test -d '/Applications/Google Chrome.app' && echo 'Chrome present' && curl -sI --max-time 6 https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/mermaid/11.4.1/mermaid.min.js | head -1

probes.fact: the CLI tools the run and the renderer invoke
check: command -v open && command -v node && command -v git && command -v python3

probes.fact: the *-it family that consumes plan-it's package (build-it, review-it, conclude-it, prompt-it) is installed
check: ls ~/.claude-loudr/plugins/marketplaces | grep -E 'build-it|devotts' | tr '\n' ' '; ls ~/.claude-loudr/skills ~/.claude/skills 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(build-it|review-it|conclude-it|prompt-it)$' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '

probes.fact: the imported brand assets and v4 inputs carry no secret-shaped strings
check: if grep -rIl -E 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|-----BEGIN (RSA|OPENSSH|PRIVATE)' assets/brand delivery/v4 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; else echo 'no secret patterns in assets/brand + delivery/v4'; fi
